directAnswer: You can check an email address for validity using online verification tools or by sending a test email to see if it bounces back.
summary: This guide provides methods to verify the validity of an email address, including online tools and manual checks.

sections.heading: Using Online Verification Tools
sections.body: There are various online services that allow you to check if an email address is valid. These tools typically check the format, domain, and whether the email is associated with a mail server.

sections.heading: Manual Check
sections.body: You can manually verify an email address by sending a test email. If the email bounces back, the address may be invalid.

steps.title: Choose an Online Tool
steps.detail: Select a reputable email verification tool such as Hunter.io, NeverBounce, or ZeroBounce.

steps.title: Enter the Email Address
steps.detail: Input the email address you want to check into the tool's search bar.

steps.title: Review the Results
steps.detail: Analyze the verification results provided by the tool to determine if the email address is valid.

steps.title: Send a Test Email (Optional)
steps.detail: If desired, send a simple email to the address to see if it bounces back.

faqs.question: What if the email address is marked as invalid?
faqs.answer: If an email address is marked as invalid, it is likely that the address does not exist or is incorrectly formatted.

faqs.question: Can I check multiple email addresses at once?
faqs.answer: Many online verification tools allow bulk checks, but be sure to check the tool's limitations.

faqs.question: Are there any free tools available?
faqs.answer: Yes, some email verification tools offer free trials or limited free checks, but they may have restrictions on the number of verifications.

caveats: Email verification tools may not guarantee 100% accuracy, as some email servers may not respond to verification requests.
